name: drift-detector
description: Detect third-party integration drift across a folder of repos — code-level API/SDK/runtime usage (via ast-grep), operation-level vendor sunsets, CVE/EOL, and an interactive dashboard, with an honest verdict that says where it is blind. Deterministic + zero-token at the core; an opt-in AI cross-check surfaces leads the rules missed, kept strictly separate from the certified findings.
